final: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count) AS avg_customers FROM store_counts) SELECT sc.store_id, sc.customer_count, CAST(sc.customer_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_customers AS share_of_total, CAST(sc.customer_count AS FLOAT) / t.avg_customers AS relative_to_average FROM store_counts sc CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY sc.store_id
